title: Rabbi Shimon HaShiloni

paragraphs: One precious homily of his survives in [Pesachim 118a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.118a). When Nebuchadnezzar cast Chananiah, Mishael and Azariah into the fiery furnace, Yurkemi, the prince of hail, stood before the Holy One, blessed be He, etc. At that moment Gabriel began and said, “And the truth of the Lord.” Rabbi Natan says: “And the truth of the Lord is forever”—the fish in the sea said it. This suggests that he was a tanna, since Rabbi Natan disagrees with him. The later phrase “as Rav Huna said” comes from the redactors of the Gemara.[^1]

notes.text: “As Rav Huna said” introduces the continuation about the Israelites’ doubts at the Red Sea.
